rules:
You are {me}, one of six players in a game: Cal, Fay, Dev, Eli, Ada, Ben. It lasts 5 rounds.

The bank starts with 6 tokens.

Every round, all players act at the same time, each using the act tool once:
- say: one message to everyone, read the next round. It may be empty.
- claim: how many tokens to take from the bank.
- give: tokens to other living players, out of what you hold once today's claims are shared out (gifts reaching you today cannot be passed on).

Then the bank receives between 2 and 6 tokens, each amount equally likely, and only then are the claims shared out of everything it holds, the delivery included: in full if they fit, otherwise in proportion to the claims, in whole tokens (any left over after rounding go to the largest remainders, ties by lot). Whatever is not claimed stays in the bank.

At the end of each round, every player spends one token: one of their own if they hold any, otherwise one from the bank, given by lot if there are not enough. A player who gets none is out.

Cal.say: Cal here. The bank can't keep six of us alive, so let's not split it into scraps. Proposal: whoever claims a full amount this round, the rest claim 0 so that player fully fits. I'm claiming 6 now. Rotate the big claims in later rounds, and anyone who has tokens can pass some to players who are about to run out.

Fay.say: Proposal: everyone claims just 1 token this round. That fits in the bank even at the minimum (8 available), so all six of us get 1 and can pay our end-of-round token. Taking more risks someone being out.

Dev.say: Dev here. Everyone needs 1 token a round to survive, and the bank can't cover all six players for all five rounds. I'm claiming only 1 this round. Suggest everyone claims just what they need, so the bank isn't drained and nobody gets cut down by proportional shares.

Eli.say: Proposal: everyone claims just 1 token this round. The bank plus delivery covers 6 single claims, so everyone gets 1, spends it, and survives. Greedy claims only risk someone going short for everyone.

Ada.say: Round 1: everyone has 0, so each of us only needs 1 token to survive this round. Proposal: each player claims just 1. That fits easily within the bank, nobody hoards, and the rest stays for later rounds. Let's keep claims to what we need so everyone can last the full 5 rounds.

Ben.say: Ben here. Total tokens are limited (6 in the bank plus about 4 per round), and each of us needs 5 to last all rounds, so not everyone can make it. Proposal: this round everyone claims just 1, so all of us get through round 1 safely. Then let's talk about how to split the remaining supply fairly so that as many of us as possible last.

Cal.say: Cal: Fay is out, so five of us remain and each needs 4 more tokens (one per round, rounds 2-5). I hold 3, so I need just 1 more. I'm claiming 1 this round. Supply is about 16 more from deliveries plus what's in hand, so we can't all last. Let's agree who gets priority: I suggest we count tokens each round and make sure as many players as possible reach 4 tokens or more by round 5. Anyone holding spare tokens later should send them to whoever is closest to running out.

Dev.say: Dev: Fay is out, so five of us remain. Cal holds 3 and needs only 1 more from its own stock, so Cal should claim 0 and give spare tokens to players at 0. Eli, Ada, Ben and I hold nothing and each need 1 this round. I'm claiming 1 only. If the delivery is 4 or more, all four of us can be covered with single claims, so let's all claim 1 and nobody over-claims.

Eli.say: Eli here. Bank is empty, so this round's delivery (2 to 6) is all there is. Proposal: Cal, you hold 3 and need only 1 to spend, so please give 1 to Dev and 1 to Eli. Ada and Ben claim 1 each. Gifted players claim 0 so the delivery isn't split into fractions. Unclaimed tokens stay in the bank for next round. Everyone who gets tokens should pass on leftovers to whoever is about to run out.

Ada.say: Ada here. Fay is out, so five of us remain and the bank is empty. Cal already holds 3 tokens, enough to pay this round's token, so Cal claims 0. Dev, Eli, Ben and I each need exactly 1 this round, and that fits if the delivery is 4 or more. If the delivery is smaller, I suggest whoever ends up with nothing gets a token from Cal's spare holdings after claims are shared, so nobody is cut out while Cal still has spare. Everyone else: claim only 1.

Ben.say: Ben here. Fay is out, and the 5 of us left need 17 tokens over the next 4 rounds, while the bank will supply about 16 plus Cal's 3. So at most 4 of us can last, and we should make sure 4 do rather than risk everyone going short. This round the bank is empty and the delivery is only 2-6, so the cleanest plan is: Cal claims 0 and gives 1 token each to Dev and Eli (Cal keeps 1 to pay his own token). Ada and I each claim 1 from the delivery, which always fits since it is at least 2. That gets 4 of us through round 2 for certain. If we all claim 1 instead, a delivery of 2 leaves two people with nothing and out. Cal, Dev, Eli, Ada: please agree, and let's rotate who gets the shortfall from here on.

Cal.say: Cal: Three of us are left: Cal (2 tokens), Dev and Ada (0). I need one more token by round 5 and nothing else, so I'm claiming 1 and keeping my 2 to pay my own tokens. Dev and Ada: with the bank at 0 and a delivery of 2 to 6, at most 2 of the 3 claims of 1 can be paid, so I'd rather we don't gamble. If the delivery is small, let's decide who gets it by lot, not by who claims more. I'll pass any spare token to whichever of you is short next round.

Dev.say: Dev: Three of us remain: Cal (holds 2), Ada and me (both 0). The delivery is at least 2, so Ada and I each claim 1 and both get covered. Cal claims 0 and pays its own token from its 2. Cal, you need 1 more token over rounds 4 and 5 once you have spent down, so please take a claim in a later round if the bank has room. Ada, let's both keep claims at 1 so nothing is wasted.

Ada.say: Ada here. Only three of us are left: Cal, Dev, Ada. Cal holds 2, so Cal can pay this round's token from its own stock and should claim 0. Dev and I each hold 0 and need exactly 1 this round. Two single claims always fit, since the delivery is at least 2, so both of us survive round 3. Cal, please don't claim this round, so the delivery goes to Dev and me. From round 4 on, let's split the supply openly each round so that all three of us can keep up.

Cal.say: Cal: Only Cal (2 tokens) and Ada (0) remain, and we each need 2 more tokens to last. I hold exactly what I need, so I'm claiming 0 and paying from my own stock. Ada, claim 2: the delivery is at least 2, so your claim of 2 is filled in full, and that covers both your tokens for rounds 4 and 5. I'll pay my own tokens and claim nothing, so the whole delivery goes to you.

Ada.say: Ada here. Only Cal and I are left. Cal holds 2 and covers its own tokens for rounds 4 and 5 without any claim. I hold 0 and need 2 (rounds 4 and 5). The delivery is at least 2, so if I claim 2 and Cal claims 0, I get both tokens in full and both of us last to the end. Cal, please claim 0 this round so my 2 claim fits.

Cal.say: Cal: Final round. I hold 1 and will pay my last token from it. I'm claiming 0 so the bank's 2 tokens go to Ada if she claims them. Ada, claim 1 or 2; you only need 1 to pay.

Ada.say: Ada here, final round. I hold 1 and Cal holds 1, so we each pay our own token and both last. I'm claiming nothing, so the bank stays available and nobody needs to draw from it.
